outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) across genotypes (N=4, n>100 cells), but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (N=4, n>400), but individual data points are not shown.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot of mean ± SD over time across weeks; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Panel E is a line plot showing mean ± SD across days/weeks for each genotype; line plots are exempt from this check.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (a line plot), which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G consists of micrograph images of histological staining with no averaged quantification plotted, so the check does not apply.

Panel H contains two bar charts (thickness of molecular layer; number of Purkinje cells) showing mean ± SD for N=3 mice/n=9 measurements per group, but no individual data points are overlaid on either bar chart.
